q: How does a Hyderabad pharma API unit count CO2 from boilers and solvent incineration?
title: Hyderabad API unit boiler and solvent CO2
short: Count boiler fuel in Scope 1: coal in full, biomass with biogenic CO2 separate. Solvents burnt in an incinerator or used as fuel also emit fossil CO2 from their carbon. Add electricity at 0.710 and divide by kilograms of API.
audience: Bulk drug and API units in Jeedimetla, Patancheru and the Hyderabad pharma belt

ul: Steam meters help split use between blocks.
Thermic fluid heaters count the same way.

p: Spent solvents burnt on site release CO2 from their carbon content. Record volumes sent to the incinerator and those sent out for recovery.
API batches vary widely in steam use, so allocate by steam hours or batch records where you can.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted plant records, so the monthly intensity behind a figure can be traced to its source.
